title: The Greatest Detective Died On Live TV, And He Was Never Even Real . . . (Episode 2)
caption:
The greatest detective died on live TV, and he was never even real. 😱 Death Note, episode 2. Follow for episode 3!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #recap #fyp
comment: Would you have written the name on live TV, or waited? Tell me below!

segments.say: The world's greatest detective died on live TV, and he was never even *real*.
To see how it happened, go back to a quiet *classroom*.
Jack sits in class, calm and polite, while a death god *grins* behind him.
After school, they walk home together, and nobody else can see the *monster*.
Jack has a simple plan. He will wipe out every *criminal* on earth.
The whole world now calls the killer *Kira*.
Police chiefs from every country meet in *secret* to stop him.
Most of them are terrified. Kira can kill anyone whose face he *knows*.
They argue for hours. In the end, they call the one man nobody has *met*.
Everyone agrees on one thing. Only this man can *catch* Kira.
Then a single letter appears on the screen, and the room goes *silent*.
He has no face and no name. The world only knows him as *L*.
L has solved cases that no police force on earth could *crack*.
Back home, Ryuk grins. The human world is the best *show* he has ever seen.
But Jack cannot relax. If anyone finds the notebook, he is *finished*.
So he builds a booby trap in his desk drawer to burn the *notebook*.
If anyone but Jack opens it, the whole thing goes up in *flames*.
Ryuk watches him work, bored, waiting for something *interesting* to happen.
Jack stretches, as if nothing in the world could *touch* him.
Jack's father is a top police officer, and his computer holds every *secret*.
So Jack breaks into it and reads the police *files*.
He reads everything, and a small smile spreads across his *face*.
They have no suspect, no clue, and no idea who he *is*.
Then, live on TV, a man looks into the camera and says, I am *L*.
He says he will stop Kira, and he is not *afraid*.
Jack doubts it. Why would the greatest detective ever show his *face*?
Then a name flashes on screen: *Lind* L. Tailor.
Jack does not wait. He writes it down and counts the *seconds*.
Seconds pass, and nothing happens. Then the man on screen clutches his *chest*.
He drops dead on live TV, in front of *millions*.
Then the screen goes dark. One white *letter* glows on it.
A cold voice says, I am the real L. That man was a *decoy*.
Lind L. Tailor was a criminal on death row. L had *planned* it all.
L says he now knows two things. Kira kills with a face and a *name*.
And the second is worse. The broadcast only aired in the *Kanto* region.
Kira killed him within seconds, so Kira must live in that *region*.
Kira is not hiding in some far country. He is *close*.
Jack freezes. L has just shrunk the entire world down to one small *map*.
He knew L was smart. He never expected L to be this *dangerous*.
Meanwhile, the police form a secret task force to hunt *Kira*.
The detectives vow to find him, no matter how long it *takes*.
Ryuk howls with laughter. The game just got *real*.
Jack clenches his fist. L is no longer a name. He is a real *enemy*.
Jack makes a vow. He will beat L, even if it costs *everything*.
But the man leading the hunt for Kira is Jack's own *father*.
